efficacy.quote: Treatment of xenograft tumors from these models revealed that, compared to ESR1 WT tumors, ESR1 mutant-expressing tumors more rapidly progressed on the combination of alpelisib and estrogen deprivation (Fig. 4e).
efficacy.confidence_note: The resistance is to the endocrine partner as much as to alpelisib; kept because the model's prediction is for the class regimen in this context. Patient side: 32 ctDNA-profiled patients in NCT01870505 (results first posted 2024-12-09), exploratory. Not in the FDA reviews.
efficacy.judgement: Retro (decision 10): built to explain a known patient result and reproduced it, so retro and counted apart from same. Comparison stated in the paper ('perhaps explaining mutation enrichment among pre-treatment ctDNA samples of patients who did not benefit'). Direction only; endpoint_role null (exploratory ctDNA association, primary objective was safety).

considered_not_added: PIK3CA-mutant metastatic patient-derived organoids treated with alpelisib (Donzelli 2022 Mol Cancer, doi 10.1186/s12943-022-01617-6, PMC9306102, full text read): PDOs from four mutant patients' metastases responded, a wild-type skin-metastasis PDO did not; no patient was reported treated with alpelisib and the authors write 'our reported findings require appropriate clinical studies for validation', so no comparison exists (model_kind ex_vivo, patient level, would be untested only).

Insulin-feedback mouse model (Hopkins 2018 Nature, doi 10.1038/s41586-018-0343-4, PMC6197057, full text read): predicts that PI3K-inhibitor-induced insulin feedback reactivates tumour PI3K signalling and that ketogenic diet/SGLT2 inhibition improves efficacy; the paper's only human data are cited trial hyperglycaemia/C-peptide, not a comparison. Registry: EPIK-B4 NCT04899349 (dapagliflozin + metformin vs metformin with alpelisib + fulvestrant, results 2023-12-12) enrolled 2 participants before termination, so uninformative; NCT05025735 (alpelisib + fulvestrant + dapagliflozin, phase 2) status unknown, no results; NCT05090358 and NCT04300790 (hyperglycaemia prevention) no results. No comparison, so not added.

mTORC1/pS6-persistence model in PIK3CA-mutant breast cancer cell lines (Elkabets 2013 Sci Transl Med, doi 10.1126/scitranslmed.3005747, PMC3935768): stated patient-level comparison (pS6 240/4 associated with tumour response to BYL719 in patients; mTORC1 reactivated at progression), but the system is the draft's PIK3CA-mutant cell-line panel (model_id pik3ca-mutant-cell-panel-xenografts): same model, different readout, so by the track-identity rule it belongs on the existing track as a 2013 patient-level patient_trials/strengthening line, not a new track.

Novartis PDX 'mouse clinical trial' (Gao 2015 Nat Med, doi 10.1038/nm.3954, ~1,000 PDXs, 62 treatments including BYL719): the abstract claims clinical translatability but names no BYL719-vs-clinic comparison; paywalled with no PMC text, so a stated comparison for a member drug could not be verified. Not added. The sponsor's own breast-cancer PDXs cited in the alpelisib review (line 1888) sit inside the draft's xenograft track.

PBPK in-silico models (Simcyp/GastroPlus): the alpelisib review compared the sponsor's PBPK DDI predictions with clinical DDI studies and found them inadequate (NDA 212526 review lines 4002-4050, 9191-9244); the 50 mg food-effect prediction was consistent with study CBYL719F12101 (NDA 218466 ClinPharmR line 526); inavolisib's PBPK DDI prediction was not accepted (NDA 219249 line 3160). These predict co-medication and food effects on PK, not the efficacious exposure target or any of the four questions, so not added as a dose track.

PROS/CLOVES postnatal mouse (Venot 2018 Nature, doi 10.1038/s41586-018-0217-9): BYL719 efficacy in PIK3CA-related overgrowth mice and 19 PROS patients; a different disease (not MONDO:0007254), and no harm or efficacy finding transfers to this context, so not a cross_indication track here.

Razavi 2020 PTEN finding (NCT01870505): Razavi built no PTEN model, so the PTEN result is scored as the first prospective entry on the Juric PDX track (paired, model_src Juric 2015), not its own track.

NEO-ORB NCT01923168 (Mayer 2019), LORELEI NCT02273973 (Saura 2019), EPIK-B5 NCT05038735 (trade press only, no registry results), INAVO121 NCT05646862 (no results): patient-side items for the existing cell-panel, ER-feedback and degrader tracks; no new model system, so left to the draft's own tracks per the checker's missing list.
Human genetic, human challenge and QSP dose-selection models: none found for this class in the searches above.
